verdicts.reason: A keeps the dark brand band with the logo and eyebrow intact and gives the headline clear dominance. But the CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill crammed against the legal text, and the body copy on the right is so large that it competes with the headline. B is worse: the white SOLSTICE wordmark sits on the cream background and is invisible, so the brand breaks. A leftover dark band fragment and the orange divider float in the top-right corner for no reason, the eyebrow has dropped below the body copy so the reading order is wrong, and the CTA is small and pushed to the corner.
